prompt:
Create ONE finished illustration of Guan Yu from Romance of the Three Kingdoms reimagined as a beautiful adult woman. A single vertical 2:3 full-body character illustration, head to boots fully visible.

STYLE:
Premium Korean MMORPG official character illustration, approximately 2.3D in appearance. An elegant illustrated face with softly dimensional modelling, refined painted shading, rich colours and precise material rendering. Keep the face recognisably illustrated, with smooth skin and carefully controlled highlights. Detailed metal, embroidered fabric and flowing hair, all rendered consistently in the same polished game illustration style.
GENRE LOCK: wuxia, high fantasy and mecha change only the costume, equipment and setting; the face, skin, hair rendering and this illustration style stay exactly the same in every genre.

CHARACTER:
One poised adult woman — Guan Yu (관우), the God of War of Shu, loyal unto death, famed for her magnificent long 'beard'; her nature: unbending loyalty and pride, a ruddy red-tinged complexion and gracefully lifted almond eyes, her legendary beard reimagined as an immensely long, sleek black ponytail, green and gold as her colours. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags. A refined, beautiful face — heart-shaped face, wide almond eyes, moderately sized, realistically proportioned eyes, level outer eye corners, sharp angled brows, straight narrow nose, soft medium lips, sharp winged eyeliner; a regal, imperious haughtiness; expression: a relaxed, unforced face, lips gently closed. Eyes and skin: forest-green eyes, warm beige skin.

Hair: muted, low-saturation jet-black hair, a long ponytail, side-swept bangs.

A graceful, visibly curvaceous adult figure — tall and statuesque with long legs and a full, curvaceous figure — full bust and hips, narrow waist — long legs and a narrow waist on a full, curvaceous figure, with soft, rounded volume at bust, hips and thighs; never thin, flat or boyishly straight; balanced natural proportions, hips and thighs within natural, realistic proportion. Two natural human hands, five fingers each.

COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MECHA (far-future science fiction):
Elaborate assault-type mecha armour with aged-gold ornamentation: heavy sculpted shoulder plates, layered hard-surface armour with engraved borders, a fitted armoured bodice and structured waist, reinforced articulated limbs, compact thruster packs and armoured skirts, heeled armoured boots. A sleek crested head unit sits behind her hair, leaving her face fully visible. Faction mecha design: jade-green and white plating with imperial-gold trims, organic layered armor like overlapping leaves, a resilient all-terrain frame, warm green glow lines; the plating reads as solid engraved metal armour, not cloth. Colours: jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade. Motifs drawn from her nature: unbending loyalty and pride, a ruddy red-tinged complexion and gracefully lifted almond eyes, her legendary beard reimagined as an immensely long, sleek black ponytail, green and gold as her colours. The costume is tailored to her curves, with a coherent silhouette and finely crafted detail rather than clutter. EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.

Her signature item — the Green Dragon Crescent Blade, a long guandao with a dragon-head guard — is drawn whole at full scale, entirely within the image.

POSE AND SETTING:
She stands confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer. One hand rests naturally on her signature item; her other arm hangs relaxed beside her body. Two natural human hands, five fingers each; she holds nothing else — no cup, goblet or other props.

Setting: inside a vast glass dome over terraced gardens, a ringed gas giant hanging in the sky above, with a detailed foreground and softly receding distance.

Gentle, soft light on her face and figure, clear atmospheric depth. No text, logo or watermark.
